answer: Proof of stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a financial ridge that deters identity proliferation. Each validator node uses a unique cryptographic cipher to sign blocks, ensuring that influence scales with wealth rather than node count. In a tundra of volatile digital assets, the cost of an attack is proportional to the total locked value, rendering the acquisition of sufficient stake prohibitively expensive for any adversary attempting to flood the network.
